quotations.old_english: Hé nolde beón cyning . . . Ðá weorðmynde cynehádes (kyne-, v. l.) hé fleáh
quotations.latin: rex fieri noluit; . . . oblatam gloriam culminis fugit

source_text: cyne-hád. In first passage for '[MS. cyneháde]' read] cynelica hád, v. l.] and add:--Hé nolde beón cyning . . . Ðá weorðmynde cynehádes (kyne-, v. l.) hé fleáh rex fieri noluit; . . . oblatam gloriam culminis fugit, Past. 33, 20.
